newsitem.title: UK: Vitol buys oil terminal and storage in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Vitol buys oil terminal and storage in Argentina.

text.p: The Dutch-based oil trading and refining company Vitol said on Thursday it had bought an oil terminal and storage facility in Argentina in a move to enhance it's position in the developing Latin American oil market.
The terminal at Zarate on the Parana River has two berths and can receive tankers of up to 50,000 tonnes deadweight on a maximum raft of 34 feet.
The Parana river is being dredged which is expected to improve the draft by another 7 feet by mid-1997.
The current storage consists of 92,000 cubic metre in six segregated tanks for unleaded gasoline, gas oil and other clean refined oil products.
The purchase was made on 22 December 1996 and Vitol has already awarded a contract to build additional tanks and make other improvements.
"This purchase is part of Vitol's strategic plan to further enhance our presence in Latin America," said Neil Kelley, managing director for Vitol's activities in North and South America.
